--- welcome

# Purpose

This survey contains 21 candidate items for an Artificial Intelligence (AI) adopter "type". The items were informed from a qualitative study [@callari2025meaningful]. At the end of the survey you will be provided a personalized report from the 21--item scale, however, the final validated measure will most likely consist of fewer items (your responses will help us refine the 21--items).

```{r}
sd_question(
  type   = "matrix",
  id     = "ES1",
  label  = "Please indicate your agreement with the following statements.",
  row    = c(
    "I primarily use AI tools to complete routine or administrative tasks more efficiently" = "ES_1",
    "I reserve AI for tasks that demand little mental effort"          = "ES_2",
    "I prefer to keep final judgment and decision-making clearly in my own hands when using AI" = "ES_3"
    ),
  option = c(
    "Strongly Disagree" = "1",
    "Disagree"          = "2",
    "Neither Agree nor Disagree"  = "3",
    "Agree"            = "4",
    "Strongly Agree"   = "5"
  )
)
```

```{r}
sd_question(
  type   = "matrix",
  id     = "ES2",
  label  = "Please indicate your agreement with the following statements.",
  row    = c(
    "I am cautious about relying too heavily on AI-generated outputs" = "ES_4",
    "Using AI tools gives me more time to connect with colleagues" = "ES_5",
    "I am confident in my ability to construct useful AI prompts" = "ES_6"
  ),
  option = c(
    "Strongly Disagree" = "1",
    "Disagree"          = "2",
    "Neither Agree nor Disagree"  = "3",
    "Agree"            = "4",
    "Strongly Agree"   = "5"
  )
)
```

--- page2

Demographics will help us develop norms (comparative distributions against which future assessment takers' scores can be evaluated) and also provide description in the eventual publication of this measure.


```{r}
sd_question(
  type  = 'select',
  id    = 'gender',
  label = "Which gender do you most closely identify with?",
  option = c(
    "Male"    = "male",
    "Female"  = "female",
    "Other"   = "other",
    "Prefer not to say" = "prefer not to say"
  )
)

# Target question
sd_question(
  type  = "text",
  id    = "gender_other", 
  label = "How do you identify?"
)
```


```{r}
sd_question(
  type  = 'mc_multiple',
  id    = 'race',
  label = "Which race/ethnic group do you most closely identify?",
  option = c(
    "White (e.g.., German, Irish, English)" = "white",
    "Black or African American (e.g.., Jamaican, Haitian, Nigerian)"           = "black",
    "American Indian or Alaska Native (e.g.., Navajo Nation, Mayan, Aztec)"       = "amind",
    "Asian (e.g.., Chinese, Filipino, Vietnamese, Korean)"               = "asia",
    "Native, Hawaiian or Pacific Islander (e.g.., Native Hawaiian, Samoan, Chamorro)"      = "native",
    "Middle Eastern or North African (e.g.., Lebanese, Iranian, Egyptian, Syrian, Moroccan)"   = "mideast",
    "Other" = "other",
    "Prefer not to say"          = "no_response"
  )
)
```

```{r}
sd_question(
  type   = 'mc',

  label  = "Do you self-identify as Latino/Latina?",
  option = c(
    "Yes" = "yes",
    "No"      = "no"
  )
)
```

